Assigned Readings & Foundational Scholarship

Please study the following research papers on transcription quality, double-keying, and error classification:

  • Haaf, Susanne, Frank Wiegand, and Alexander Geyken. "Measuring the Correctness of Double-Keying: An Error-Classification for Evaluation of Text Digitisation." Language Resources and Evaluation, 49(4), 2015, pp. 759–789.
  • Griffitts, Troy. "Digital Editing of Biblical Texts." Manuscript Cultures: Mapping Textual Landscapes, § 4.5.2 (Reconciliation and Collation Baselines).
